answer_1.quote: Data-to-text (D2T) generation aims to generate a natural language description conditioned on structured or semi-structured data, such as graphs or tables.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we employ the widely used metric, BLEU and ROUGE-L, to evaluate the fluency of generated text. And we utilize SacreBLEU to calculate the BLEU after segmenting the sentcne by jieba. Additionally, we utilize COVERAGE to evaluate the faithfulness of generated text.

answer_4.quote: five native Chinese annotators (three females and two males) with master's degrees or above engaged in NLP research are invited to evaluate the quality from the four axes.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated FLUENCY, FAITHFULNESS, COVERAGE, and REPETITION.
